about.title: From coding the core to leading the bank
paragraphs: Debesh began his career in 1994 as a Computer Programmer at Rastriya Banijya Bank, writing and maintaining the bank's core systems. Over three decades he rose through project management, data-centre leadership and Chief of IT to Deputy Executive Officer and, from June 2024 to February 2026, Deputy Chief Executive Officer, oversaw IT, Digital Banking, HR, Compliance, Payment & Settlement, Branch Operations and more. Now, exchanging ideas on IT, IT-security, digital banking, fintech and total digital transformation.

Alongside banking, he has served as the bank's Chief Information Security Officer and Information Officer, advised national e-governance and microfinance programmes funded by ADB, and has taught MBA, MScIT and BScIT students since 2006.
